method: Expand missing behavioral evidence, reproduce actual failures, assign bounded fixes only when necessary, independently review exact results, preserve every prior candidate and failure.

Record exact method/path/status and state assertions against current registry, not empty-array or role-gate-only success. Preserve partial and policy-blocked cases.

Exercise real loopback HTTP behavior for existing workflow, agent/AI policy, memory, operations and automation modules where synthetic setup is available. No live inference or delivery, no fabricated approval or passing fake provider. Map observed branches and authorization negatives to exact registrations.

Validate baseline hashes, coordinate local fixtures and independent reviews; do not edit product source. Updated coverage cannot imply whole-roadmap or release acceptance.

constraints: Luna-only coding and independent review, high reasoning; one writer per scope
No product/test/harness edits without a separately recorded reproduced defect and ownership transfer
